_meta.purpose: Verified fund data for the landing page and README. Every field has a source URL. Do not add values without a source.

status_legend.verified: Read directly from the issuer's official page or document on the access date
status_legend.derived: Computed from verified data (method stated in note)
status_legend.unverified: Not confirmed from a primary source - do not publish as fact

_meta.second_pass: 2026-10-08: added trailing dividend yield (past 365 days) per fund; see claims-verification.md F2 for method and cross-checks.

exchange_rate.source: Czech National Bank (CNB) foreign exchange market rate (kurz devizoveho trhu) - the rate the Income Taxes Act points to (s. 38(5) ZDP)
exchange_rate.note: Used only to show USD values in CZK. Cost lines are % of a CZK amount and do not depend on it. Brokers convert at their own rate plus markup, not at the CNB rate.

_meta.single_source_rule: Before production this file is the ONLY source of fund data. The page (card, overview, methodology) and the email (table, your-check block) must load it and derive figures from it; no second copy. Calculations use the RAW inputs: distributions_per_share_usd / nav_usd (unrounded yield), or the issuer-published yield value for SPY and SPYM. Rounded fields (trailing_dividend_yield_pct.value for computed funds, us_withholding_drag_pct_per_year) are for reading only, not inputs.
_meta.rounding_rule: CZK outputs: 3 significant digits, never finer than whole CZK, ties half-up (see claims-verification.md F3).
_meta.fund_order: Alphabetical by ticker; the default selection is the first fund (IVV).
